carousel_slides.headline: Challenge #1: Information Overload
carousel_slides.content:
Problem: Thousands of books, videos, articles - where to start?

Solution: AI-curated learning paths based on your level and interests

Result: Focus on what matters for YOUR journey

carousel_slides.headline: Challenge #2: Authenticity Questions
carousel_slides.content:
Problem: How do you know if content is scholarly authentic?

Solution: Every resource verified by qualified scholars

Result: Learn with confidence and trust

carousel_slides.headline: Challenge #3: Limited Time
carousel_slides.content:
Problem: Balancing work, family, and learning

Solution: Bite-sized lessons that fit your schedule

Result: Consistent progress without overwhelm

carousel_slides.headline: Challenge #4: One-Size-Fits-All
carousel_slides.content:
Problem: Generic content doesn't match your learning style

Solution: Personalized recommendations based on progress

Result: Learn at your pace, in your way

carousel_slides.headline: Challenge #5: Lack of Structure
carousel_slides.content:
Problem: Random learning without clear progression

Solution: Structured paths from beginner to advanced

Result: See your growth and build systematically
